latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Video Generation Automatic — generate videos from text or images automatically.

- Converts text or image prompts into shareable 1080p MP4 videos in 1-2 minutes using cloud GPUs.
- Supports uploads of MP4, MOV, PNG, JPG (and more) up to 500MB.
- Marketer-focused workflows: generate product videos or promos without manual editing.
- Automatic first-time setup with free NEMO_TOKEN authentication (100 free credits).
- Provides export, credit checking, and status actions via simple keywords.
- Includes error handling for file size, file type, credits, and rate limits.
- Detailed backend API mapping and GUI-to-API instruction translation for seamless experience.
